name: modellr
product: Modellr: free, open-source, local-first database schema designer (static React app)
scope: interactive+functional (the app already works end to end; this work redesigns the public site and app chrome)
direction: Blueprint (chosen by the owner from mockups A/B/C)
stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, react-router 7, Zustand, React Flow; vitest
research_limits: Org egress policy returns 403 for every closed reference site (linear.app, vercel.com, stripe.com, dbdiagram.io, drawsql.app, ...). Live CSSOM was therefore read from the two open-source direct competitors run locally (drawDB, ChartDB); closed products are covered by third-party DESIGN.md write-ups (VoltAgent/awesome-design-md), explicitly marked secondary evidence.
